about: pq-verify 2.19.0 output (macOS arm64, Python 3.13, hash-pinned wheel), one folder per run: argv.json, exit_code, stdout.txt, stderr.txt and report.json when written. Paths are replaced by <BUILD>, <OUT>, <VENV>; timestamps by <TIMESTAMP>; inodes by null. expect is the i-nist status PQ-Proof must give; venv full has the extras, min has none. The em dash (U+2014) in pq-verify's text is replaced with a hyphen.

a-full-good-kem.why: PQClean ML-KEM-768 clean: input-check stages only (NIST invalid keys accepted)

b-full-bad-kem.why: PQClean with ss[0] flipped in decaps

b2-full-mlkemnative-bad-kem.why: mlkem-native with ss[0] flipped in decaps

c-min-good-kem.why: pq-verify without extras: same result as a (library audits use no extras)

c2-min-mlkemnative-kem.why: pq-verify without extras: same result as a2

e-input-error-missing-path.why: library path does not exist: exit 2, no report

f-full-dsa65.why: PQClean ML-DSA-65 (pure interface only): VERIFIED but scope partial (171 not applicable)

f2-full-dsa65-require-full-coverage.why: f with --require-full-coverage: exit 1, status VERIFIED, scope partial

g-min-acvp-kem.why: --acvp without kyber-py: CANNOT VERIFY, DEGRADED RUN, not a library audit

g3-full-acvp-kem-require-full-coverage.why: --acvp VERIFIED, but it checks pq-verify's own references, not a library

h-full-mlkemnative-kem-constant-time.why: --constant-time on macOS: valgrind missing, reported as a finding

j-full-mlkemnative-contained.why: --audit-contained on macOS: CANNOT VERIFY, not bound to a file
